[[File:Nightbird's Mark New.png|right]]The '''Nightbird's Mark''' is an Attack Module that enhances Critical Damage and Evade.

==Description==
''The mark of a giant female ninja robot. It exposes weaknesses in enemies, increasing the effectiveness of your Base Defender's Critical Hits. Doctor Fujiyama would be proud.''

==Max Stats==

* 1-Star
** Health: 219
** Attack: 19
** Rating: 38
* 2-Star
** Health: 456
** Attack: 40
** Rating: 97
* 3-Star
** Health: 2,776
** Attack: 242
** Rating: 590
* 4-Star
** Health: 5,965
** Attack: 519
** Rating: 1,177 (sig 55)

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* Enhanced Criticals
* Evade

=== Abilities ===
* ''Critical Hits''
** +40~120% Critical Damage
** +5% Armor penetration
* ''Passive''
** +4% chance to Evade incoming Melee attacks.
** Successfully Evading an attack grants +100% Critical Rate for your next attack.

== Strategy ==

=== '''On Base''' ===
It is recommended to pair this Module with Bots who frequently deal Critical hits, and so is suited for most [[Warrior|Warriors]], [[Scout|Scouts]], and [[Demolitions|Demolition]] Bots. [[Cheetor]] and [[Dinobot]] also rely on Critical Hits, Cheetor for his basic Melee Bleed and Dinobot for almost his entire skillset. [[Bumblebee]] will benefit from this Mod as his Shield Breaks will be inflicted more frequently.

Bots who also have powerful evading such as [[Bumblebee (DOTM)]], [[Barricade]] and [[Sideswipe]] will be evading more attacks.

It is unknown if [[Thundercracker]] can score a Crit while under this mod.

=== '''Raids''' ===
'''Avoid starting a fight below 7 to 25% health, your Bot will get knocked out instantly.''' This is especially true with [[Megatron (ROTF)]], whose Repair won't trigger at all, and [[Megatronus]], who won't be able to go immortal, if either are Culled.

There are some bots that are an effective counter to this mod, like [[Hot Rod]]'s Deceleration and [[Grindor]]'s Crit Rate Debuffs. [[Optimus Primal]] completely resists Critical Hits, and [[Bonecrusher]] will Bleed anyone who Crits.
